description: Send MedaRep the rep's feedback on an answer, in their own words: rating wrong, missing (left out something they needed), not_useful or useful, with comment (what they said), tool (the tool whose answer it is about; the latest answer of it is tied in), about (the surgeon, territory or company) and expected (what they say is right). preference keeps a lasting wish about how answers should be ("shorter", "lead with my customers"), carried with every later answer to them; forgetPreferences clears those. Only feedback the rep gave; no patient information.

about.description: What the answer was about: a surgeon's name or NPI, a territory, a company.

comment.description: The rep's own words about the answer.

expected.description: What the rep says is right, when they said.

preference.description: A lasting preference about how answers should be, in the rep's words.

tool.description: The tool whose answer this is about, e.g. surgeon_profile.

name: answer_feedback
title: Send feedback on an answer
